# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 10 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #12140d);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #ecefdd);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #12140d;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #12140d | #ecefdd | Text on bg and panel. Flips to light in dark mode. |
| `--ink-2` | #3a3d30 | #c4c8b1 | Secondary text and nav links. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--accent-soft, #f5facb);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--accent-soft, #2b330c);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f5facb;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--accent-soft` | #f5facb | #2b330c | Soft lime wash for hover and ready states. |
| `--on-accent` | #12140d | #12140d | Text on accent. Stays dark in both themes. |
| `--on-action` | #ffffff | #12140d | Text on action. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--bg, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--bg, #0d0f09);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bg` | #ffffff | #0d0f09 | Page background. White in light; a green-black in dark. |
| `--panel` | #ffffff | #14170e | Cards and sheets that sit on the page. |
| `--wash` | #f7f8f1 | #1a1d13 | Faint tint for small wells such as stack tiles. |
| `--sunk` | #eff2e3 | #1a1d13 | Illustration zones inside cards; white chips lift off it. |
| `--mute` | #5e6256 | #9aa085 | Captions and fine print. Passes 4.5:1 on bg in both themes. |
| `--line` | #e2e5d3 | #262a1c | Hairlines and dividers, tinted to the page hue. |
| `--accent` | #e3f23f | #e3f23f | Lime. A fill only, for what you act on or what is ready. Never used as text on bg. |
| `--term` | #12140d | #050603 | Terminal and code panels. Dark means something you run. |
| `--action` | #12140d | #ecefdd | Fill of the primary neutral button. Inverts in dark. |

| ramp | step and value (light) | step and value (dark) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--line-*` | 2 #c9ceb5 | 2 #373c29 |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 4.75rem/1 "Fraunces", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-hero); letter-spacing: -0.03em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hero` | `.hero`, `--text-hero` | 4.75rem / 1, letter-spacing -0.03em | 600 | `display` | One per page. Scales down to 3.25rem on phones. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 3.75rem / 1.04, letter-spacing -0.025em | 600 | `display` | Section headings. 2.5rem on phones. |
| `card-title` | `.card-title`, `--text-card-title` | 1.44rem / 1.2, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `display` | Card and component titles. |
| `lede` | `.lede`, `--text-lede` | 1.25rem / 1.55 | 400 | `sans` | Intro paragraph under a headline. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 1.03rem / 1.6 | 400 | `sans` | Running text. |
| `ui` | `.ui`, `--text-ui` | 0.94rem / 1.4, letter-spacing 0.005em | 600 | `sans` | Buttons, nav, labels. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 0.85rem / 1.4 | 500 | `sans` | Fine print, captions, tags. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 0.81rem / 1.75 | 400 | `mono` | Filenames, commands and terminal output only. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Fraunces", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Geist", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Tight gaps inside controls. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between small items; tile grids. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Card inner padding on phones. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Default gap. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between groups. |
| `--space-7` | 28px | Page gutter on desktop (18px on phones). |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Gap between blocks in a section. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Section padding on phones. |
| `--space-24` | 96px | Section padding on desktop. |

## Shadow

